final_reply:
All 6 of Priya's open deals are now at 20% probability.

| Opportunity | Stage | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hooli - Analytics Add-on | Value Proposition | 50% | 20% |
| Vandelay - Import Tracking | Qualification | 10% | 20% |
| Oceanic Shipping - Port Integration | Proposal/Price Quote | 75% | 20% |
| Stark Logistics - Warehouse Sensors | Proposal/Price Quote | 75% | 20% |
| Vandelay - Analytics Starter | Needs Analysis | 20% | 20% (no change needed) |

- **Oceanic Shipping:** The first update said it worked, but when I checked, the deal was still at 75%. I updated it again, and the record now shows 20%.
- **Stage defaults:** This sets the probability by hand, so the two Proposal/Price Quote deals are now well below the usual 75% for that stage. Two early-stage deals went up from 10%. If a deal's stage changes later, Salesforce may reset its probability to that stage's default.
